sourceTables.query: SELECT *, id AS p_id, CAST(parse_extension(address[0].extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation,latitude', 'valueDecimal', '') AS FLOAT) AS p_latitude, CAST(parse_extension(address[0].extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation,longitude', 'valueDecimal', '') AS FLOAT) AS p_longitude, parse_extension(extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race,ombCategory', 'valueCoding', 'code,system') AS p_race_standard, parse_extension(extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-race,ombCategory', 'valueCoding', 'code') AS p_race_code, parse_extension(extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity,ombCategory', 'valueCoding', 'code,system') AS p_ethnicity_standard, parse_extension(extension, 'http://hl7.org/fhir/us/core/StructureDefinition/us-core-ethnicity,ombCategory', 'valueCoding', 'code') AS p_ethnicity_code FROM Patient

sourceFields.fieldCalculatedValue: concat_ws('', address[0].country, address[0].city, address[0].postalCode, address[0].line[0], address[0].line[1])

sourceTables.query: SELECT e.*, e.id AS e_id, p.id AS p_id, pr.id AS pr_id, o.id AS o_id FROM (SELECT *, filter(participant, x -> x.individual.type = 'Practitioner')[0] AS participant_practitioner FROM Encounter) e LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(child.id) AS id, child_i.value AS value, child_i.system AS system, child_i.type.coding[0].code AS type_code FROM Patient child LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS child_i GROUP BY child_i.value, child_i.system, child_i.type.coding[0].code) p ON p.value = e.subject.identifier.value AND (p.system = e.subject.identifier.system OR (p.system IS NULL AND e.subject.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (p.type_code = e.subject.identifier.type.coding[0].code OR (p.type_code IS NULL AND e.subject.identifier.type.coding[0].code IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(child.id) AS id, child_i.value AS value, child_i.system AS system, child_i.type.coding[0].code AS type_code FROM Practitioner child LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS child_i GROUP BY child_i.value, child_i.system, child_i.type.coding[0].code) pr ON pr.value = e.participant_practitioner.individual.identifier.value AND (pr.system = e.participant_practitioner.individual.identifier.system OR (pr.system IS NULL AND e.participant_practitioner.individual.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (pr.type_code = e.participant_practitioner.individual.identifier.type.coding[0].code OR (pr.type_code IS NULL AND e.participant_practitioner.individual.identifier.type.coding[0].code IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(child.id) AS id, child_i.value AS value, child_i.system AS system, child_i.type.coding[0].code AS type_code FROM Organization child LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS child_i GROUP BY child_i.value, child_i.system, child_i.type.coding[0].code) o ON o.value = e.serviceprovider.identifier.value AND (o.system = e.serviceprovider.identifier.system OR (o.system IS NULL AND e.serviceprovider.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (o.type_code = e.serviceprovider.identifier.type.coding[0].code OR (o.type_code IS NULL AND e.serviceprovider.identifier.type.coding[0].code IS NULL))

SELECT o.*, o.id AS o_id, p.id AS p_id, e.id AS encounter_id FROM Observation o LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(child.id) AS id, child_i.value AS value, child_i.system AS system, child_i.type.coding.code AS type_code FROM Patient child LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS child_i GROUP BY child_i.value, child_i.system, child_i.type.coding.code) p ON p.value = o.subject.identifier.value AND (p.system = o.subject.identifier.system OR (p.system IS NULL AND o.subject.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (p.type_code = o.subject.identifier.type.coding.code OR (p.type_code IS NULL AND o.subject.identifier.type.coding.code IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(enc.id) AS id, enc_i.value AS value, enc_i.system AS system, enc_i.type.coding.code AS type_code FROM Encounter enc LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS enc_i GROUP BY enc_i.value, enc_i.system, enc_i.type.coding.code) e ON e.value = o.encounter.identifier.value AND (e.system = o.encounter.identifier.system OR (e.system IS NULL AND o.encounter.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (e.type_code = o.encounter.identifier.type.coding.code OR (e.type_code IS NULL AND o.encounter.identifier.type.coding.code IS NULL))

SELECT * FROM (SELECT InnerPractitioner.*, InnerPractitioner.id AS p_id, PractitionerRole.specialty AS practitionerrole_specialty, Organization.id AS org_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY InnerPractitioner.id ORDER BY InnerPractitioner.id) AS row_num FROM Practitioner AS InnerPractitioner LEFT JOIN (SELECT practitioner.identifier.value AS practitionerrole_value, practitioner.identifier.system AS practitionerrole_system, practitioner.identifier.type.coding[0].code AS practitionerrole_type_code, specialty, organization FROM PractitionerRole WHERE practitioner.identifier.value IS NOT NULL) AS PractitionerRole ON SIZE(FILTER(InnerPractitioner.identifier, identifier -> identifier.value = PractitionerRole.practitionerrole_value AND (identifier.system = PractitionerRole.practitionerrole_system OR (identifier.system IS NULL AND PractitionerRole.practitionerrole_system IS NULL)) AND (identifier.type.coding[0].code = PractitionerRole.practitionerrole_type_code OR (identifier.type.coding[0].code IS NULL AND PractitionerRole.practitionerrole_type_code IS NULL)))) > 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT Organization.id, org_identifier.value AS organization_value, org_identifier.system AS organization_system, org_identifier.type.coding[0].code AS organization_type_code FROM Organization LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS org_identifier WHERE org_identifier.value IS NOT NULL) AS Organization ON PractitionerRole.organization.identifier.value = Organization.organization_value AND (PractitionerRole.organization.identifier.system = Organization.organization_system OR (PractitionerRole.organization.identifier.system IS NULL AND Organization.organization_system IS NULL)) AND (PractitionerRole.organization.identifier.type.coding[0].code = Organization.organization_type_code OR (PractitionerRole.organization.identifier.type.coding[0].code IS NULL AND Organization.organization_type_code IS NULL))) AS Practitioner WHERE Practitioner.row_num = 1

select *, id as o_id, cast(parse_extension(address.extension[0], 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation,latitude', 'valueDecimal', '') as float) as o_latitude, cast(parse_extension(address.extension[0], 'http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/geolocation,longitude', 'valueDecimal', '') as float) as o_longitude from Organization

sourceFields.fieldCalculatedValue: concat_ws('', address[0].country, address[0].city, address[0].postalCode, address[0].line[0], address[0].line[1])

sourceTables.query: SELECT c.*, p.id AS p_id, enc.id AS encounter_id FROM Condition c LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(child.id) AS id, child_i.value AS value, child_i.system AS system, child_i.type.coding.code AS type_code FROM Patient child LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS child_i GROUP BY child_i.value, child_i.system, child_i.type.coding.code) p ON p.value = c.subject.identifier.value AND (p.system = c.subject.identifier.system OR (p.system IS NULL AND c.subject.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (p.type_code = c.subject.identifier.type.coding.code OR (p.type_code IS NULL AND c.subject.identifier.type.coding.code IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(enc.id) AS id, enc_i.value AS value, enc_i.system AS system, enc_i.type.coding.code AS type_code FROM Encounter enc LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS enc_i GROUP BY enc_i.value, enc_i.system, enc_i.type.coding.code) enc ON enc.value = c.encounter.identifier.value AND (enc.system = c.encounter.identifier.system OR (enc.system IS NULL AND c.encounter.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (enc.type_code = c.encounter.identifier.type.coding.code OR (enc.type_code IS NULL AND c.encounter.identifier.type.coding.code IS NULL))

SELECT mr.*, mr.id AS mr_id, p.id AS p_id, pr.id AS pr_id, encounter.id AS encounter_id FROM MedicationRequest mr LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(child.id) AS id, child_i.value AS value, child_i.system AS system, child_i.type.coding[0].code AS type_code FROM Patient child LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS child_i GROUP BY child_i.value, child_i.system, child_i.type.coding[0].code) p ON p.value = mr.subject.identifier.value AND (p.system = mr.subject.identifier.system OR (p.system IS NULL AND mr.subject.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (p.type_code = mr.subject.identifier.type.coding[0].code OR (p.type_code IS NULL AND mr.subject.identifier.type.coding[0].code IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(child.id) AS id, child_i.value AS value, child_i.system AS system, child_i.type.coding[0].code AS type_code FROM Practitioner child LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS child_i GROUP BY child_i.value, child_i.system, child_i.type.coding[0].code) pr ON pr.value = mr.requester.identifier.value AND (pr.system = mr.requester.identifier.system OR (pr.system IS NULL AND mr.requester.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (pr.type_code = mr.requester.identifier.type.coding[0].code OR (pr.type_code IS NULL AND mr.requester.identifier.type.coding[0].code IS NULL)) AND mr.requester.type = 'Practitioner' LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(enc.id) AS id, enc_i.value AS value, enc_i.system AS system, enc_i.type.coding[0].code AS type_code FROM Encounter enc LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS enc_i GROUP BY enc_i.value, enc_i.system, enc_i.type.coding[0].code) encounter ON encounter.value = mr.encounter.identifier.value AND (encounter.system = mr.encounter.identifier.system OR (encounter.system IS NULL AND mr.encounter.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (encounter.type_code = mr.encounter.identifier.type.coding[0].code OR (encounter.type_code IS NULL AND mr.encounter.identifier.type.coding[0].code IS NULL))

SELECT p.*, p.id AS p_id, pa.id AS pa_id, e.id AS e_id FROM Procedure p LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(child.id) AS id, child_i.value AS value, child_i.system AS system, child_i.type.coding[0].code AS type_code FROM Patient child LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS child_i GROUP BY child_i.value, child_i.system, child_i.type.coding[0].code) pa ON pa.value = p.subject.identifier.value AND (pa.system = p.subject.identifier.system OR (pa.system IS NULL AND p.subject.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (pa.type_code = p.subject.identifier.type.coding[0].code OR (pa.type_code IS NULL AND p.subject.identifier.type.coding[0].code IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(child.id) AS id, child_i.value AS value, child_i.system AS system, child_i.type.coding[0].code AS type_code FROM Encounter child LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS child_i GROUP BY child_i.value, child_i.system, child_i.type.coding[0].code) e ON e.value = p.encounter.identifier.value AND (e.system = p.encounter.identifier.system OR (e.system IS NULL AND p.encounter.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (e.type_code = p.encounter.identifier.type.coding[0].code OR (e.type_code IS NULL AND p.encounter.identifier.type.coding[0].code IS NULL))

SELECT dr.*, p.id AS p_id, e.id AS e_id FROM (SELECT dr.id AS dr_id, dr.*, encounter_exploded.identifier.value AS encounter_value, encounter_exploded.identifier.system AS encounter_system, encounter_exploded.identifier.type.coding[0].code AS encounter_type_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dr.id ORDER BY dr.id) AS row_num FROM DocumentReference dr LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(dr.context.encounter) AS encounter_exploded) dr LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(child.id) AS id, child_i.value AS value, child_i.system AS system, child_i.type.coding[0].code AS type_code FROM Patient child LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS child_i GROUP BY child_i.value, child_i.system, child_i.type.coding[0].code) p ON p.value = dr.subject.identifier.value AND (p.system = dr.subject.identifier.system OR (p.system IS NULL AND dr.subject.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (p.type_code = dr.subject.identifier.type.coding[0].code OR (p.type_code IS NULL AND dr.subject.identifier.type.coding[0].code IS NULL)) LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(child.id) AS id, child_i.value AS value, child_i.system AS system, child_i.type.coding[0].code AS type_code FROM Encounter child LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS child_i GROUP BY child_i.value, child_i.system, child_i.type.coding[0].code) e ON e.value = dr.encounter_value AND (e.system = dr.encounter_system OR (e.system IS NULL AND dr.encounter_system IS NULL)) AND (e.type_code = dr.encounter_type_code OR (e.type_code IS NULL AND dr.encounter_type_code IS NULL)) WHERE dr.row_num = 1
select *, id as s_id, idOrig as s_idOrig , msftModifiedDatetime as s_msftModifiedDatetime, resourceType as s_resourceType from Specimen

SELECT ims.*, exp_series.uid AS series_uid, ims.id AS ims_id, p.id AS p_id FROM (SELECT ims.*, EXPLODE(ims.series) AS exp_series FROM ImagingStudy ims WHERE ims.subject.type = 'Patient') ims LEFT JOIN (SELECT MAX(child.id) AS id, child_i.value AS value, child_i.system AS system, child_i.type.coding[0].code AS type_code FROM Patient child LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(identifier) AS child_i GROUP BY child_i.value, child_i.system, child_i.type.coding[0].code) p ON p.value = ims.subject.identifier.value AND (p.system = ims.subject.identifier.system OR (p.system IS NULL AND ims.subject.identifier.system IS NULL)) AND (p.type_code = ims.subject.identifier.type.coding[0].code OR (p.type_code IS NULL AND ims.subject.identifier.type.coding[0].code IS NULL))
